optionsSubTitle.message: Manage platform preferences, sync settings, and data backup

enableDesc.message: Choose which AI platforms will run the AIChatFolders extension.

syncDesc.message: Automatically sync local folder records when chats are renamed or deleted in native sidebar

cloudSyncDesc.message: Sync folders and saved chats across your devices via your browser's own sign-in sync. This is a separate folder set from local storage — switching modes does not carry your existing folders over. Off by default.

exportDesc.message: Export all folders and node structures to a JSON file

importDesc.message: Restore folder structure from a JSON config file

importFailed.message: Failed to import. Please check if the file format is valid JSON.

refreshNotice.message: Please refresh the corresponding page after changing the settings.
